instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Use React Router (BrowserRouter, Routes, Route) for main layout and dedicated case study routes (/work/crm, /work/design-system, /work/analytics).
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add unique kebab-case data-testid to every button, link, input, card, menu, and key metric for robust automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react icons throughout the application. NEVER use raw emoji characters for icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.no_transparent_nav: Ensure the navbar always has a solid/semi-solid backdrop-blur background bg-[#09090B]/80 with z-50 to prevent transparency overlap issues.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_type: Remember all frontend components must be written as JavaScript (.js) files, not TypeScript (.tsx).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop: use custom, dark-first styling with generous spacing, distinct typography, and rich micro-interactions.
Ensure high contrast compliance on all text and active interactive elements.
Add hover, active, focus states, and Framer Motion entrance reveals to all cards and buttons.
Keep standard smooth scrolling enabled via Lenis or Framer Motion scroll triggers.
